confirmation: sealed fifth state for narrow conditional transfer; multiple sealed states and state-level power for broad transfer
global_pair_holdout: reserve exact unordered pair identities across every state and every response-consuming source; incident guard rows unused
query_reference_adaptation: declare matched query controls and singles, gene alignment/panel adaptation and normalization before sealed outcomes
precision_protocol: configs/experiments/dose-design-20261007.json; sensitivity scenarios are hypothetical, not a powered empirical design
interventions: select a shared target panel from qualified single-effect coverage and biological effect diversity
time_and_reagent_policy: same declared intervention conditions across contexts; record guide assignment and efficacy
replication: prospective precision/power calculation; independent biological cultures and randomized batches
selection_policy: metadata/reference-only panel selection before combination outcomes; preserve a sealed confirmation block
